name: Rune-Inscribed Note
label: Quest
description: Rune-Inscribed Note: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, friend. I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As quickly as water falls from the sky, here you are before me. I am pleased by your haste. It means you realize both the importance of our meeting and you being here. I am no leader, but I do understand the elements, and I can speak to the spirits of our people. I will teach you to do the same.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We will meet many times in the days to come. Each time you will hopefully leave my company a little more powerful... A little more prepared. Like the Eternal Flame, your spirit will burn bright and hot.
Go now, friend. Go and test yourself. I will be here for you when you need.
